profile.name: Tarry Singh
profile.positioning: Founder-CEO and hands-on AI leader for CEO and Chief AI Officer / CTO mandates: 30 years turning data and AI into operating capability for energy, telecoms, financial-services and public-sector organisations across Europe, the Gulf and the United States, with a builder's edge in peer-reviewed AI research, a European foundation-model programme and industrial AI delivered in the field.

closingLine.text: Data first, models second, and the client keeps the keys.

eras.title: Earlier career: from operations to enterprise data
eras.thesis: Moved from operational management in oil and transportation (1994 to 1999) into data leadership: head of data and programme manager at the Royal Wagenborg group (2000 to 2003), then lecturer and head of data and middleware in Groningen (2003 to 2007).

eras.title: Data and infrastructure at scale
eras.thesis: Built and ran a pan-EMEA data, virtualisation and cloud practice at Atos, then co-founded an advisory firm that delivered data-driven IT transformation, governance and sourcing for large enterprises.

eras.title: Analytics and digital transformation
eras.thesis: As a director in PA Consulting's data analytics and digital practice, led data, digital and sourcing engagements for private and public-sector clients across Europe, and built the practice's data-science bench.
eras.wave: Big data, analytics and digital platforms

eras.title: Founder-CEO: deep learning in the field
eras.thesis: Founded an AI group, DK AI Holding with Real AI and EarthScan, and took deep learning into telecoms, healthcare and energy, from hands-on engineering programmes to industrial computer vision.

eras.title: Foundation models, sovereignty and AI education
eras.thesis: Leads the industrial side of a European foundation-model programme, co-develops EU-funded AI master's programmes and turns the research into a product stack and open, hands-on AI courses.
eras.wave: Generative and agentic AI under the EU AI Act
